prompt: Validate that all test files in CLAUDE.md end with '_test.go' and are located in the same directory as the code they test.
criterion: All test files must have the suffix '_test.go' and reside in the same directory as the corresponding production code.

prompt: Ensure all Go files in the CLAUDE.md project use the standard package comment format starting with 'Package <name> provides'.
criterion: Each Go file must have a package comment immediately after the package declaration, starting with 'Package <name> provides' and ending with a period.

prompt: Verify that the CLAUDE.md project uses only stable, versioned dependencies listed in go.sum.
criterion: All dependencies must be pinned to specific versions in go.sum; no v0, v1, or unreleased versions are allowed.

prompt: Require that all structs in CLAUDE.md have field tags for JSON marshaling, even if empty.
criterion: Every struct field that may be serialized to JSON must have a json tag, even if it is empty: `json:""`.

prompt: Confirm that all Go source files in the CLAUDE.md project use tab indentation with 8-character tab stops.
criterion: All source files must use tabs for indentation, not spaces, and no line may contain more than 8 characters per tab stop.

prompt: Verify that all error returns in CLAUDE.md are checked immediately after the function call.
criterion: Every function call returning an error must be followed by an explicit error check on the next line.

prompt: Ensure that the CLAUDE.md project includes a LICENSE file in the root directory with a valid open-source license.
criterion: The project root must contain a LICENSE file with a recognized open-source license text, such as MIT or Apache 2.0.

prompt: Ensure all internal packages in CLAUDE.md are located under a directory named 'internal' and are not imported by external packages.
criterion: No external package outside the module may import any package under the 'internal' directory.

prompt: Require that all functions in CLAUDE.md with more than 10 lines of code include a comment explaining their purpose.
criterion: Every function exceeding 10 lines must have a preceding comment summarizing its behavior, not just restating the code.

prompt: Ensure the CLAUDE.md project uses consistent naming for variables: camelCase for exported, and camelCase for unexported.
criterion: All variable names must use camelCase; no underscores or snake_case are permitted in any variable declaration.
